member.name: OdooFilter
member.summary:
Builder of an Odoo domain - list of conditions like ["name", "=", "Test"] used to filter records.
Conditions are joined with AND by default. Logical operators are prefix (Polish notation) and apply to the next two conditions: Or().EqualTo("a", 1).EqualTo("b", 2) means a = 1 OR b = 2. Not() applies to the next condition.
Prefer typed , which takes property expressions instead of field names.

member.name: OdooFilterOfT
member.summary: Typed builder of an Odoo domain for model : fields are given as property expressions (x => x.Name) and translated to Odoo field names from [JsonProperty]. Same rules as : AND by default, prefix Or() / And() / Not().

member.name: OdooFilterValue
member.summary: List of values for In / NotIn conditions, built fluently with .

member.name: OdooFilterValue.AddValue
member.summary: Adds a value to the list.

member.name: Create
member.summary: Creates empty filter - matches all records.

member.name: Build
member.summary: Returns this filter. Kept for compatibility - the filter can be used directly.

member.name: Or
member.summary: Adds OR operator (|) - the next two conditions are joined with OR instead of AND.

member.name: And
member.summary: Adds explicit AND operator (&) for the next two conditions - needed only inside OR / NOT groups, AND is the default.

member.name: Not
member.summary: Adds NOT operator (!) - negates the next condition.

member.name: EqualTo
member.summary: Adds condition field = value. Use false as value to find empty fields.

member.name: NotEqual
member.summary: Adds condition field != value.

member.name: GreaterThan
member.summary: Adds condition field > value.

member.name: GreaterThanOrEqual
member.summary: Adds condition field >= value.

member.name: LessThan
member.summary: Adds condition field < value.

member.name: LessThanOrEqual
member.summary: Adds condition field <= value.

member.name: Between
member.summary: Adds condition value1 <= field <= value2 (both bounds inclusive), sent to Odoo as '&', (field, '>=', value1), (field, '<=', value2).

member.name: Like
member.summary: Adds case sensitive "contains" condition (Odoo like) - value may be any part of the text.

member.name: ILike
member.summary: Adds case insensitive "contains" condition (Odoo ilike) - value may be any part of the text.

member.name: NotLike
member.summary: Adds case sensitive "does not contain" condition (Odoo not like).

member.name: In
member.summary: Adds condition field in values - field equals any of the values. For many2many / one2many fields: contains any of the ids.

member.name: NotIn
member.summary: Adds condition field not in values - field equals none of the values.

member.name: BeNull
member.summary: Adds condition "field is empty" (Odoo field = False).

member.name: NotBeNull
member.summary: Adds condition "field is set" (Odoo field != False).

member.name: ChildOf
member.summary: Adds condition child_of - records under the given record(s) in a hierarchy (e.g. product categories, companies), including the given record(s) themselves.

member.name: ParentOf
member.summary: Adds condition parent_of - records above the given record(s) in a hierarchy, including the given record(s) themselves.
